authority_notes: Pure in-memory capacity-one job shop. Tool runs happen outside and report back through the typed API; only synthetic runs exist here — no process, project file, license, or physical Tool PC is touched. The public-safe artifact-isolation MCP and ACP probe are test fixtures whose physical Hermes execution is separately evidenced; they grant no runtime or network authority. Workshop success yields a done_candidate custody receipt only (claim workshop_output_candidate_only); acceptance, promotion, and task completion have no surface. Binding a physical Tool PC/runner is a separately Owner-gated leaf; that runner must honor the current fencing token and treat a stale token as a hard stop.
